purpose: W3-B foundation: establish the complete versioned document requirement/type/status matrix around the existing canonical DealDocument authority, without creating DocumentV2 or mutating signed documents.
authorization: Owner instruction on 2026-09-05 to continue the supplied PC-CROP post-registration specification with existing push/PR/merge authorization. Implementation remains blocked until this finite scope is independently accepted and promoted into immutable base-state authority.

excludedAfterSourceAudit.reason: Existing DealDocument remains canonical. The first slice stores document registry/lifecycle policy in a dedicated document_engine schema and introduces no second public document model.
Barrel publication is deferred to consumer wiring to avoid shared-file collisions with concurrent work.
The current hard-coded 9-type matrix is source evidence, not modified by the foundation. Replacement wiring is a separately accepted consumer slice.
Existing canonical document writer/immutability remains unchanged in the registry foundation.
The first registry foundation is unmounted; API/user flow is later work.
Global CI remains an independent gate.

requiredInvariants: Reuse the existing canonical DealDocument immutable-version writer; do not create DocumentV2 or an alternative signed-document authority.
The registry covers every required document type from section 18 and every required lifecycle status; aliases may exist only as explicit versioned mappings, never as silently divergent types.

DocumentRequirement is versioned by role, Deal stage, service/regulatory applicability and blocking action. A requirement change creates a new policy version and does not rewrite historical Deal obligations.
Lifecycle transitions are a closed state machine. SIGNED content is immutable; correction produces a new version/status path and cancellation/archive preserve the signed/history chain.
A document type/status registry entry does not manufacture document existence, signature, delivery, acceptance, EDO receipt or regulatory finality.
Requirements derive from authoritative Deal/service/regulatory facts; browser-selected document type/status or client-side gate results never become authority.
Every published registry/policy version is approved, effective-dated, content-hashed and immutable after publication.
All registry/policy tables/functions live in a dedicated document_engine schema with FORCE RLS/memberless command ownership and atomic event/audit/outbox receipts.
Existing signed DealDocument versions, storage hashes and signature evidence are never edited by this foundation.
Registration, Role Eligibility, Contract foundation, Signature/MChD, Settlement, Federal Accounting lock #4321, packages/lockfiles and production topology remain unchanged.
acceptance: Contract tests prove all required document types and statuses are present exactly once in the canonical registry vocabulary.
Restricted PostgreSQL tests prove registry publication/versioning, immutable effective versions, tenant isolation and current-authority replay checks.
The lifecycle policy rejects forbidden transitions, especially mutation of SIGNED bytes/history and direct jumps that fabricate SENT/DELIVERED/ACCEPTED finality.
Historical Deal requirement snapshots remain pinned when a newer registry/policy version is published.
Direct UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE and outsider/cross-tenant access are denied.
Exact replay returns the original receipt; changed payload conflicts; audit/outbox/hash failure rolls back the publication command.
No existing DealDocument row or hard-coded matrix consumer is mutated in the foundation and no public Prisma schema drift is introduced.
Forward migration, restore, cryptographic freshness and exact-head CI/review pass before implementation merge.
remainingTerminalBoundary: Consumer wiring must replace the current hard-coded document matrix without weakening canonical DealDocument immutability.
Generation/rendering for each required type, EDO delivery receipts and signature authority remain separate slices.
Role-specific document UI/search/states and REG.RU real-user acceptance remain required before terminal DOCUMENT_ENGINE credit.
